note: A decimated surface of a uCT gerbil skull registered to the atlas (METHODS.md, 'The skull'): o = origin (mm), s = quantisation step (mm), v/f = base64 little-endian uint16 vertices (offsets from o, in steps) and triangle indices, nv/nf their counts, sil = projection silhouettes, lm = landmark heights. There is no generator for this file in the repository; it is the one asset that cannot be rebuilt from source.
